# MouseWait <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MouseWait:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of the button that was pressed.

## Description

The older name of [WaitMouse](WaitMouse). It stops the program until a mouse button is pressed and returns the button.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Text 10, 10, "Click a mouse button"
Flip
Local b = MouseWait()
Cls
Text 10, 10, "That was button " + b
Flip
Delay 1000
```
